items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Bunk left New Orleans about 1910 and I didn't see Bunk no more until 1937 and I didn't know Bunk.

ctx.x: He never, all his trouble that Bunk ever got into was himself. Himself. See, just drinking. And Bunk, just didn't start drinking. Bunk was drinking for a long time. Bunk left New Orleans about 1910 and I didn't see Bunk no more until 1937 and I didn't know Bunk. See, I know the Bunk but I didn't know Bunk when I seen him, you know, at all of me. And Bunk would've known me until he asked Louie who is that. See, he, cause you know when you go in the towns and the names up there, it says, Louie, who's that boy, I…
